### workspace current --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace current

Print the workspace project name for the current directory.
Detects worktree projects via .workspace-project marker files,
then falls back to matching active project roots.

Examples:
  workspace current    # which workspace am I in
  workspace current | xargs workspace focus    # bring this workspace's window to the front from a script
  workspace current | xargs workspace dir    # the root directory of the workspace I am in
--- stderr
--- end
